summary: Database flags are filesystem paths, never SQLite URI parameters, and novel store flags are MCP read paths.
reason: SQLite interprets query strings as connection options. Reject URI metacharacters before opening any local state and classify paths for MCP host policy.
reapply: Validate db and db-path after profile flags resolve, before database scope/store access. Refuse ? and # with usage exit 2. All novel db-path flags need mcp:read-flags db-path.
